caveats: Rate secondary (grade S): 18% from 1 January 2025 (17% until 31 December 2024) from VATCalc's 2026 table; gov.il blocked automated fetches this session.
individualTaxYear is the calendar year, inferred from the country's annual assessment cycle (grade I); not confirmed on the authority's own pages in this pass.
companyYearEndDefault is a 31 December app default for new entities (grade I), not a statutory requirement; companies may choose other year ends under national law.
The 17% rate applied from 1 October 2015 (VAT Order published 10 September 2015; OECD Consumption Tax Trends dates the change to October 2015) until the rise to 18% on 1 January 2025.
